contradictions.subject: P05/P12 design-token edge direction

side_a.summary: Graph of record: edge P05_Forum -> P12_Concordia, relation CONSUMES_DESIGN_TOKENS, transport CSS custom properties and ARIA bridges.

side_b.summary: Architecture document draws the arrow the other way: P12 supplies accessibility design tokens to P05.

contradictions.affected_contract: Concordia design-token and ARIA bridge contract consumed by the Forum shell; producer identity.
contradictions.resolution: D05: P12 Concordia produces the design tokens and P05 Forum consumes them; the graph edge identifier is kept with the direction annotated (M16).

contradictions.subject: P06/P09 action-gate edge direction

side_a.summary: Graph of record: edge P06_Justitia -> P09_Minerva, relation ACTION_GATE_INTERCEPT, pre-execution risk-tier gate and approval routing.

side_b.summary: Architecture document draws P09 -> P06: Minerva raises the pre-execution interception request.

contradictions.affected_contract: Action-proposal schema between P09 Minerva and P06 Justitia (allow, block or escalate).
contradictions.resolution: D03: propose/intercept semantics. P09 proposes and P06 intercepts and decides; the graph edge identifiers are kept (typed in M14).

contradictions.subject: P06/P09 action-gate transport: three transports named for one edge

side_a.summary: Transport recorded as the eBPF action_gate program combined with D-Bus.

side_b.summary: Communication matrix records a Unix domain socket with a sub-500 microsecond budget.

contradictions.affected_contract: P06/P09 wire contract: bus name, socket path, eBPF map or ring-buffer layout, and the sub-500 microsecond budget.
contradictions.milestone: M14; eBPF half re-verified in M19 and M10

contradictions.subject: P06 -> P10 syscall-interception edge existence

side_a.summary: Draws a P06 -> P10 syscall-interception edge carried by the action_gate eBPF program.

side_b.summary: No P06 -> P10 edge exists among the 28 edges; Vesta is reached only from P09 by capsule execution.

contradictions.affected_contract: Whether Justitia gates Vesta syscalls directly or transitively through P09; Vesta admission path.
contradictions.resolution: D04: recorded as unresolved in M14; both the direct P06 to P10 path and the transitive path through P09 are contract-tested in M06 before the graph is changed.

contradictions.subject: P09/P14 code-CAD verification edge direction

side_a.summary: Graph of record: P09_Minerva -> P14_Hephaestus, relation VERIFY_CODE_CAD, parametric constraint and dimension checks.

side_b.summary: Architecture document draws P14 -> P09 for the same solver-backed verification.

contradictions.affected_contract: Code-CAD verification request and result schema; which side owns the solver invocation.
contradictions.milestone: M06 (P09 router and solver); P14 slice M08

contradictions.subject: P15/P02 local-database storage edge existence

side_a.summary: Draws P15 -> P02 for local database storage on the dedicated Btrfs subvolume.

side_b.summary: P15_Hestia has exactly one outbound edge, to P04 for overlay registration; no P15 -> P02 edge exists.

contradictions.affected_contract: Hestia storage contract against the P02 var-partition subvolume, snapshot and encryption ownership.
contradictions.milestone: M17 (Hestia slice); definitions M03, lifecycle M15

contradictions.subject: Ledger hash algorithm: three algorithms for one ledger

side_a.summary: Graph of record names a BLAKE3 checkpoint ledger as the P06 -> P16 audit transport.

side_b.summary: The P06 audit-record schema field for the previous record is a SHA-256 hex digest of the previous signed block.

contradictions.affected_contract: Signed audit-record schema (P06 to P16) and the Athena ledger hash-chain trait.
contradictions.resolution: D02: SHA-256 hash chain behind a hash-algorithm trait; MD5 excluded; BLAKE3 only through a later recorded decision. The graph string is annotated, not edited, at M01.

contradictions.subject: Focus-indicator width: 3px token against a 2px stroke

side_a.summary: Token file sets a focus-ring width of 3px with a 2px offset, and raises the width again inside the forced-colors block.

side_b.summary: Report requires a focus indicator with a minimum 3:1 contrast ratio and a 2px stroke width, and declares a 2px token.

contradictions.affected_contract: Concordia focus-ring token contract and the accessibility boundary assertion consumed by the P05 shell.
contradictions.resolution: D16: a 3px focus-ring token with a 2px minimum enforced by the boundary test. The forced-colors override must not be read as a violation.

contradictions.subject: CSS framework: framework fork against token-only delivery

side_a.summary: Section prose describes Concordia as a fork of a monolithic CSS framework with improved accessibility.

side_b.summary: The trade-off matrix in the same source records design tokens as chosen and monolithic CSS libraries as discarded.

contradictions.affected_contract: ui/concordia-tokens dependency surface and the P05/P12 token contract (tokens against framework classes).
contradictions.resolution: D17: design tokens without a monolithic CSS library; the framework-fork statement is superseded. Both sides are the same source id, which is a source-internal conflict.

contradictions.subject: Boot kernel identity: distribution package against a produced kernel artefact

side_a.summary: The image content package list names a real-time distribution kernel package with no version.

side_b.summary: The shared ownership table assigns kernel configuration, patch selection and artefact production to the Nucleus repository.

contradictions.affected_contract: Aegis-side kernel requirement payload (LSM, sched_ext, BTF, RAPL, VFIO/IOMMU, KVM; ABI; architectures) and the image content list.
contradictions.milestone: M18 (schema); consumed at M09 and M11; eBPF re-verification M10
contradictions.resolution: D07: both. The image boots a pinned distribution real-time kernel by default and a Nucleus artefact overrides it once M09 delivers one. The version floor stays open (D55).

contradictions.subject: P08/P11 remote-play capture edge direction

side_a.summary: Graph of record: P08_Calliope -> P11_Ludus, relation REMOTE_PLAY_CAPTURE, a sub-5 millisecond encoded video stream.

side_b.summary: Architecture document draws P11 -> P08 for the same buffer-sharing capture stream.

contradictions.affected_contract: Capture contract: which subsystem opens the stream and owns the sub-5 millisecond encode budget.
contradictions.milestone: M07 (P08) and M08 (P11); GPU path M12

contradictions.subject: P12/P15 accessibility-enforcement edge direction

side_a.summary: Graph of record: P12_Concordia -> P15_Hestia, relation ENFORCE_A11Y_STANDARDS, conformance assertions.

side_b.summary: Master diagram draws the Hestia application as a consumer of Concordia, the reverse direction.

contradictions.affected_contract: Ownership of the accessibility assertion gate for the Hestia surface: producer enforcing or application consuming.

contradictions.subject: P13 -> P05 carbon-telemetry budget: delivery deadline against emission interval

side_a.summary: Communication matrix records a D-Bus signal with a sub-2 millisecond figure for power and carbon updates.

side_b.summary: Communication matrix records the same signal interface with a one-second interval.

contradictions.affected_contract: Telemetry signal contract: emission period against delivery deadline, and the shell status-bar refresh assertion.

contradictions.subject: P04 -> P05 compositor/shell endpoint and budget stated by one source only

side_a.summary: Graph of record: P04_Mercurius -> P05_Forum over a Unix socket stream, with no endpoint path and no budget.

side_b.summary: The only source naming the socket path and a sub-100 microsecond budget; export-002 omits the edge entirely.

contradictions.affected_contract: Compositor and shell IPC contract: socket path, framing, and which budget the contract test asserts.
contradictions.milestone: M07 (producer) and M16 (consumer with stubbed IPC)

contradictions.subject: P06 -> P05 decision-request edge: absent from one document, budget exceeds the gate

side_a.summary: Communication matrix records a D-Bus decision-request prompt with a sub-1 millisecond figure.

side_b.summary: No Justitia to shell edge appears in the master diagram or the matrix; Justitia connects only to Minerva and the TPM.

contradictions.affected_contract: Versioned decision-request schema and whether the human-oversight prompt sits inside the sub-500 microsecond interception gate.

contradictions.subject: P09 -> P10 capsule execution: transport, endpoint and latency disagree

side_a.summary: Graph of record: a virtual-socket transport named together with a Go Wasm runtime; the P10 node budget is a sub-125 millisecond microVM boot.

side_b.summary: Communication matrix records the same virtual-socket family with a concrete address and a sub-1 millisecond budget.

contradictions.affected_contract: Vesta capsule-dispatch contract: address and port, fallback, and whether the budget covers a warm call or a cold boot.

contradictions.subject: P07 -> P09 VRAM swap: transport disagreement and a different endpoint

side_a.summary: Graph of record: transport is the kernel GPU scheduler priority path plus a dynamic VRAM allocator, with no bus call.

side_b.summary: Communication matrix adds D-Bus with a sub-100 microsecond budget and an explicit inference-pause payload.

contradictions.affected_contract: Broker to agent pause and swap control contract: a bus method on the agent daemon or a scheduler-only action.

contradictions.subject: P03 -> P09 weight-streaming endpoint: subsystem target against hardware target

side_a.summary: Graph of record: P03_Vulcan -> P09_Minerva over a peer-to-peer DMA path; export-002 agrees with this direction.

side_b.summary: Draws the peer-to-peer path from storage to the GPU and from P03 to the GPU, with no P09 endpoint.

contradictions.affected_contract: Weight-streaming contract: whether Minerva requests a stream from Vulcan or only observes a programmed hardware path.
contradictions.milestone: M17 (P03 validation crate); DMA evidence M12

contradictions.subject: Eight graph-of-record edges appear in neither architecture document

side_b.summary: Draws sixteen edges and names none of the eight; export-003 lists six matrix rows and names none of them either.

contradictions.affected_contract: Eight interface contracts with a single supporting source each; none can be typed as a two-source-agreed edge.

contradictions.subject: Five edges present in the graph and one document but absent from the other

side_a.summary: Carries P08->P04, P10->P16, P13->P07, P16->P13 and P06->P05; export-002 carries the same five.

side_b.summary: None of the five relations appears in the master diagram or the matrix.

contradictions.affected_contract: M05 evolution loop, M06 sandbox evaluation, M07 buffer-sharing stream; P06->P05 is tracked separately in DSP-15.

contradictions.subject: Node set: hardware, kernel and transport nodes outside the sixteen-subsystem graph

side_a.summary: Declares sixteen nodes and 28 edges; every node is a subsystem, and hardware and transports appear only as attribute strings.

side_b.summary: Adds CPU, GPU, storage, TPM, three eBPF programs, a mesh transport and a sidecar protocol as first-class nodes.

contradictions.affected_contract: Owner of the TPM attestation contract (P02 or direct hardware access) and of sidecar dispatch (P04 or an unowned transport).

contradictions.subject: Btrfs subvolume set for the var partition

side_a.summary: The partition definition declares five subvolumes for the var partition.

side_b.summary: The storage model prose lists only four of the same five subvolumes.

contradictions.affected_contract: P02 var-partition definition validated offline, and the database subvolume the Hestia storage dependency rests on.

contradictions.subject: P04 compositor implementation: mandated C library against a pure-Rust scaffold

side_a.summary: The report rejects higher-level abstractions and mandates a C-based compositor library for absolute control of the event loop.

side_b.summary: The only code artefact is pure Rust with no foreign-function binding to that library and no version pinned anywhere.

contradictions.affected_contract: P04 registry and IPC state-machine backend, and the admitted toolchain (a C toolchain against a Rust-only workspace).
contradictions.resolution: D08: pure Rust compositor; the C library mandate is superseded (ADR-0001). No C compositor toolchain is admitted.

contradictions.subject: P15 Hestia location: Rust crate against UI package

side_a.summary: The file header places Hestia under crates/aegis-hestia as a Rust daemon for the productivity and application engine.

side_b.summary: The directory map lists only ui/hestia-app for P15 and carries no crates/aegis-hestia row.

contradictions.affected_contract: P15 component path in the inventory and the typed boundary between the Rust logic and the Svelte package.
contradictions.resolution: D09: both. A Rust crate for the storage and vector logic and a Svelte package for the UI, with a typed boundary (M17).

contradictions.subject: P10 Wasm capsule runtime against the language-boundary rule

side_a.summary: A Rust daemon describes its capsules in terms of a Go-implemented Wasm runtime; the graph repeats that runtime in the transport string.

side_b.summary: Shared package reuse must respect language boundaries: a Go library is not a direct dependency of a Rust daemon without an adapter and contract tests.

contradictions.affected_contract: Vesta capsule-execution contract and the crate dependency set; also the P09 -> P10 transport string.
contradictions.resolution: D06: a Rust-native WebAssembly runtime selected at M06 through the template matrix; no Go runtime and no protocol adapter. The graph string is annotated, not edited.

contradictions.subject: P11 proprietary SDK against the subsystem's own open-source constraint

side_a.summary: The report wraps proprietary C++ SDK headers through a binding generator to isolate the runtime from that ABI.

side_b.summary: The trade-off matrix records free and open-source compliance as the declared constraint for the same subsystem.

contradictions.affected_contract: P11 crate dependency set and the image content list; a licence decision before any SDK is vendored.
contradictions.milestone: M08 (negative test proves crate and image build without it)
contradictions.resolution: D12: the proprietary SDK is excluded from the Aegis image; P11 covers only free and open-source integration paths (ADR-0002).

contradictions.subject: P02 security model: reversible consolidation against permanent hardening

side_a.summary: The trade-off matrix poses reversible structural consolidation against permanent hardening for the P02 security model.

side_b.summary: Root-hash verification must make the read-only root filesystem bit-for-bit identical to the signed release before it is trusted.

contradictions.affected_contract: P02 A/B candidate lifecycle state machine against the root-integrity requirement.
contradictions.resolution: D13: reversible structural consolidation, reconciled with root-hash integrity in M15.

quarantined_artifacts.claims: Three jobs: a Rust format, lint and test gate called a Power-of-Ten check; an image synthesis and headless boot verification; and an accessibility conformance gate.

defects.defect: Failure suppression in both definition validators
defects.evidence: Each validation step ends in a shell true fallback, so a malformed partition geometry or transfer definition reports success (REQ-CI-01).
Dependency install and browser install both end in a true fallback, so the job stays green with nothing installed.

defects.defect: Conformance reported without executing the check
defects.evidence: The accessibility suite itself ends in a true fallback, so a gate named for a conformance standard can never fail (REQ-CI-02).
Every action is referenced by a mutable tag or branch rather than a commit digest; one toolchain action floats on a branch.
A now end-of-life Node major is hardcoded, conflicting with the imported guide's own major (REQ-CI-03).

defects.defect: Simulated boot output pulled into CI
defects.evidence: The boot step executes the imported integration script, which prints boot, measurement and integrity success without starting an emulator (REQ-BOOT-02).

defects.defect: No pinned toolchain for the image job
defects.evidence: The Rust channel resolves at run time and image packages install unversioned from the runner distribution, so the job is not reproducible.
No job compiles or verifier-loads any of the three eBPF programs, although the workflow calls itself an invariant check.

quarantined_artifacts.replacement_milestone: No whole-file replacement: the Rust gate is authorable at M02, the accessibility gate at M04, the eBPF gate at M19, and image synthesis with a real boot gate at M11.

quarantined_artifacts.claims: On any version tag push: build, synthesize a boot image, sign it, generate provenance and publish a non-draft, non-prerelease public release with the image, its signature and an integrity artefact.

defects.defect: A tag push alone can create a release
defects.evidence: No manual gate, no environment approval and no artefact precondition; release delivery is blocked until M13 (D11).
Draft and prerelease are both false with generated notes, so a single accidental tag becomes a real published release (REQ-REL-01).

defects.defect: Unverified third-party action with write permissions
defects.evidence: The toolchain action namespace resolves to HTTP 404 inside a job holding contents, identity-token and packages write (REQ-REL-02).
Every action floats on a mutable tag, including the reusable provenance workflow and the action that creates the release.
Write permissions are granted at workflow level to every step, including the unverified action, rather than scoped to the publishing step.
Keyless signing is enabled through an experimental flag; no signature is verified, no certificate identity policy is asserted and no signer attestation is retained.
The subject list is a single hash over a file set where encoded per-artefact digests are expected, and a reusable workflow is invoked from a step position.
The release includes an integrity artefact that no step in the workflow produces, and no boot or measurement evidence is collected anywhere.

quarantined_artifacts.replacement_milestone: M13 (release signing and remote delivery), and not before an M11 artefact exists and the unverified action reference is replaced with a digest-pinned, verified action.

quarantined_artifacts.claims: States that it evaluates partition geometries, boot of the unified image and daemon interfaces, and validates a headless boot with measurement, integrity and volume unlock.

defects.evidence: The branch prints a simulation notice and sleeps; no emulator, firmware, TPM emulator or container runner is invoked anywhere in the file.
A boot success line and specific measurement register values are printed although no TPM was read (REQ-BOOT-02).
A root-hash verification line is printed with no hash computed and no device mapped.
A policy-based volume unlock line is printed with no volume and no policy evaluated.

defects.defect: Success printed without executing the check
defects.evidence: A loop prints a pass line for each of nine hardcoded crate names; no path is inspected and no build tool is invoked, so it would pass in an empty directory.
Presence of one definition file is reported as geometry verified; contents are never parsed and three further definitions are never checked.
The script always reaches a success banner and exits zero; the advertised daemon interface evaluation is never implemented.

quarantined_artifacts.replacement_milestone: Split: offline definition validation with real exit codes at M03; a real boot check with retained emulator logs and measurement readback at M11; signing at M20. Until then no gate may reference it.

quarantined_artifacts.claims: Targets for build, eBPF, UI, test, lint, format, accessibility, image and boot, advertised as enforcing Power-of-Ten build invariants and zero-drift compilation.

defects.defect: Simulated output inside the test gate
defects.evidence: The test target runs the simulated integration script, so a green test run includes fabricated boot and measurement passes (REQ-P14-08).
A fixed epoch and an all-zero seed are baked into the image target, which makes every build produce identical partition identifiers on every machine.
The UI build re-resolves and mutates the lockfile instead of installing from it, contradicting the zero-drift claim in the same file.
Only one of the three imported eBPF programs is compiled, and no verifier load is attempted.
It boots an image path that no target in the file produces and passes an SSH key into the guest, an undeclared credential path into a supposedly immutable image.
The build, compiler and image tools are taken from the path with no version pin and no availability check.
No target runs the repository's verification, audit or context-compile checks, so adopting the file would replace the governance gate.

quarantined_artifacts.replacement_milestone: Target by target: Rust targets at M02, accessibility at M04, a complete eBPF target with verifier load at M19, image and boot targets at M11. The tracked Makefile stays authoritative.

quarantined_artifacts.claims: States that it initialises the canonical directory layout, places all scaffolded files into it, and then prints a completion banner.

defects.evidence: The final permission change ends in a true fallback; under strict error handling it is the only guarded command, so the suppression is deliberate.

defects.defect: Success printed without executing the work
defects.evidence: Every copy is guarded on source existence, with no counter, manifest check or digest verification, so the banner prints whether it copied fifty files or none.
Five copies have identical source and destination when run from the root, which the copy tool rejects, so the run aborts mid-population or silently does nothing.
It copies proposal standards data over the tracked governance configuration with no diff, review or backup.
It installs the failure-suppressing CI and the tag-triggered publishing workflow into the workflow directory in one unreviewed step.

defects.defect: References a source that does not exist
defects.evidence: It copies a second root partition definition that exists nowhere in the import set; the existence guard swallows it and the A/B scheme is created without a B slot.
It creates twelve crate source trees with no manifests, no workspace root and no lock, producing a tree that cannot build.

quarantined_artifacts.replacement_milestone: None: superseded outright. Each component's directory, manifest, lock and interface contract are created by hand at the milestone that activates it. Bulk population by script is not reintroduced.

quarantined_artifacts.claims: A deterministic hash-chained audit trail said to enforce Power-of-Ten invariants for experiment and candidate auditing, appending records linked by a previous-record hash.

defects.evidence: The header advertises one hash algorithm and the implementation computes another; this is the ledger-hash contradiction recorded as DSP-07.
The algorithm is hardcoded at the call site with no trait or injection point, so the boundary D02 requires does not exist.
A system-wide absolute path is the default constructor argument; it needs elevated rights to create and is not configurable per environment.
Only the last line is parsed and its self-declared hash is adopted as the chain head; nothing recomputes a record hash or walks the chain.
File read, parse and property access are unguarded, so a truncated final line, the normal outcome of a crash mid-append, throws out of the constructor.
Appends without locking or flushing, so concurrent writers interleave; records carry no signature and the encoding order is never pinned.
No positive, negative or boundary test accompanies a public interface, so the three-dimensional testing invariant is unmet.

quarantined_artifacts.replacement_milestone: The trait boundary and D02 land at M02; a corrected ledger with chain verification, canonical encoding, injected storage and three-dimensional tests at M05; signed records at M14 and M20.

quarantined_artifacts.claims: An accessibility audit suite named for a European conformance standard: a rule-engine scan asserting zero violations, and a focus-indicator test named for a contrast ratio and a stroke width.

defects.evidence: The focus test reads style, width and colour but asserts only that the outline style is not none; contrast is never computed and width is never compared.
The single substantive assertion discards the two other collected properties, so the D16 width boundary is not implemented.
Both tests navigate to a hardcoded local development origin with no managed server, fixture or readiness gate, so in CI the load fails and the suppressed job still reports a pass.
Nothing asserts that removing the focus outline fails the suite, and no case exercises the minimum width, which M04 requires.

defects.defect: Coverage narrower than the conformance claim
defects.evidence: One route in its default state is scanned behind a single selector, while conformance is claimed for the whole shell.
The test runner and rule engine are imported with no version pinned anywhere in the import set.

quarantined_artifacts.replacement_milestone: M04 (accessibility harness): headless against a managed server, zero violations on the default state, failing when the focus outline is removed, and implementing the D16 boundary.

quarantined_artifacts.claims: Seven Rust unit tests covering risk-tier routing, maker-checker separation, two-checker enforcement for high-risk actions, decision timeout fail-closed behaviour and a global killswitch.

defects.defect: Tests its own mock, not product code
defects.evidence: The engine and every type are defined inside the test-only module, so nothing ships and a release build compiles none of it; M02 requires library code.
Six unwrap calls on clock durations and a result; a pre-epoch clock would panic the interceptor instead of failing closed, against the error-handling invariant.
Expiry uses a strict comparison, so a request due in the current second is still approvable; the boundary fails open, and no test covers the equality case.
The only expiry case is one second past due; nothing exercises the equality edge that the strict comparison leaves open.
Two imports are unused, which alone fails the required deny-warnings lint gate.
The constructed request is bound to a discarded name and dropped, so the returned identifier refers to no record and the approval path is unreachable from interception.

defects.defect: Test-only constant left in the engine
defects.evidence: A short approval window is hardcoded into the engine with a comment admitting it is for testing; the timeout is policy and belongs in configuration with its own bounds.

defects.defect: High-risk path not enforced at interception
defects.evidence: The tier match never branches on the high-risk flag, so a high-risk action declared at the lowest tier is simply allowed and the two-checker rule is never consulted.
The killswitch test covers only the lowest tier; no test covers audit-record emission or hash chaining, and no hashing or signing boundary exists.

quarantined_artifacts.replacement_milestone: M02 (P06 promoted end-to-end): library code in the crate behind a workspace root and a committed lock, no unwrapping, equality failing closed, and three-dimensional tests under the lint gate.
